title: Diameter: Enhancements for S6c messages
description:
Good Day,

This Merge Request will provide decoding of AVPs within S6c messages: associating the user-name with an IMSI, decoding SRR-Flags, decoding of the feature-list, and decoding the BCD SC-Address and MSC-Number.

I'm sorry for resubmitting this, but, I'm not great at certain git actions.  Hopefully this is cleaner on the new MR.
